notifyui.title: Notifications
notifyui.intro: One-way: Kut sends you messages and accepts no commands from outside. Messages never contain keys, configs, QR codes or passwords. Off by default; once enabled, Kut connects only to the addresses below.
notifyui.token_saved_ph: saved (paste a new token to change it)
notifyui.wh_saved_ph: saved: {host} (paste a new URL to change it)
notifyui.chat_filled: Chat ID filled in; press Save.
notifyui.telegram_hint: In Telegram, message @BotFather with /newbot, create a bot and paste the token it gives you below. Then send /start to your new bot and press "Find chat". Notifications go to that chat only.
notifyui.webhook_hint: Every notification is POSTed to this URL as JSON (ntfy, Discord, home automation…). The URL may contain a secret key; once saved it is never shown again, only the host name.
notifyui.ev_security_hint: Login from a new IP, repeated failed logins, password/2FA/account changes. Delivered during quiet hours too.
notifyui.ev_device_hint: A device connected for the first time, a device that has not connected for 24 hours, an expired guest.
notifyui.quiet_hint: During quiet hours system and device notifications are skipped (not sent later); security notifications still arrive. Times are server time.
